title: pred_model config JSON (v0.1.0a8 documentation snapshot)
description: Documentation-owned schema snapshot for the pred_model --config JSON in exact release v0.1.0a8. test_data reuses the nested test-data contract (single-source or multi-source). Not a canonical runtime definition. Forbidden top-level keys include wandb, loss, optimizer, max_epochs, early_stopping, init_checkpoint, and attribution*. Runtime also validates CUDA, array contents, and composition uniqueness.
